description: Read-only (constant) call against any TRON contract, executed by our own node. TRC-20 helpers balanceOf / allowance / decimals / symbol / name / totalSupply are built in; any other function can be called with a raw selector plus ABI-encoded parameter. No state is changed and no key is involved. When to use: an agent needs an on-chain value without trusting a third-party API - USDT balance of an address, token decimals, an allowance, or any view function. Do not use: to send a transaction (this never writes), or to look up a historical balance. Returns: ok, contract, function, output_type, value (decoded), value_human for 6-decimal tokens, raw, energy_used.

function.description: balanceOf | allowance | decimals | symbol | name | totalSupply, or a raw selector like 'foo(uint256)'

parameter.description: Raw ABI-encoded parameter hex, for raw selectors

name: tron_read_contract
title: Tron Read Contract
